the asymmetric alkylation of the 2,3-dienes with soft carbon nucleophile proceeded efficiently in the presence Pd(0) complex to give optically enriched functionalized allenes.
the palladium-catalyzed asymmetric alkylation of the 2,3-allenylphosphates is an efficient and practical methodology for the synthesis of functionalized allenes in high optical purity.

the synthesis and application of optically active functional allenes.
the development of new synthetic methods to prepare chiral allenes.
the development of new synthetic methods to prepare functionalized allenes, and their applications to the synthesis of natural products and bioactive compounds.
